title.narrative: Providing life-saving and life-sustaining Protection (GBV) interventions in hard-to-reach areas in As-Sweida and Aleppo governorates.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project will implement comprehensive GBV interventions in underserved areas of As-Sweida and Aleppo governorates. The activity design is informed by a comprehensive needs assessment conducted in both governorates in July 2024 (annex 11 21) and February 2025 to inform the location change to Jebel Saman in Aleppo. Additionally, NCA has triangulated this information using a multi-sectoral assessment carried out by its partner GOPA/DERD in May 2024 (annex 12), as well as through coordination with the GBV sub-sectors, local stakeholders, and other organizations operating in these areas.ltbrgtNCA’s interventions align with OCHA’s Strategic Priorities 1 and 2. Under Priority 1, NCA will deliver essential GBV services in the subdistricts of Milh (As-Sweida) and Al-Khafsa (Aleppo), focusing on life-saving and life-sustaining GBV interventions. Under Priority 2, the project aims to enhance the resilience of vulnerable communities by providing vocational trainings and CVA to women and girls, including GBV survivors.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtGBV Interventions:ltbrgtComprehensive GBV response and prevention services will be delivered through GOPA/DERD in Rural As-Sweida and EPDC in Rural Aleppo. Both partners have established Women and Girls Safe Spaces (WGSS) and family centers in the respective areas within accessible distance from Milh and Al-Khafsa subdistricts. These centers serve as bases for mobile services to reach the most underserved communities.ltbrgtThe project will leverage the expertise of partner staff previously trained by NCA. Ongoing capacity building will be provided to ensure the highest quality of service delivery. A key advantage of this project is the strong community acceptance and trust that both partners have established in the target areas, based on their long-term presence and consistent provision of GBV services.ltbrgtOutcome 1 under GBV will include case management, CVA, referrals, structured psychosocial support sessions for women and girls, and mental health and psychosocial support services.ltbrgtOutcome 2 will focus on prevention and empowerment services, including vocational training for women and girls, particularly GBV survivors and on outreach and awareness-raising activities aimed at creating lasting change by advocating for women’s and girls’ rights, challenging harmful gender norms, and preventing future instances of GBV.ltbrgtlt/pgt
